ValidationRule.description: Enforces 30% discount cap on DCS bundle products
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( Product2.ProductCode = 'CYB-DCS-ESS-BUN', Product2.ProductCode = 'CYB-DCS-ESS-BUN-V2', Product2.ProductCode = 'CYB-DCS-ADV-BUN', Product2.ProductCode = 'CYB-DCS-ADV-BUN-V2', Product2.ProductCode = 'CYB-DCS-ELITE-BUN', Product2.ProductCode = 'CYB-DCS-ELITE-BUN-V2', Product2.ProductCode = 'CYB-DCS-CLOUD-BUN', CONTAINS(Product2.Name, 'DCS'), CONTAINS(Product2.Name, 'Bundle') ), Discount > 30, TEXT(Quote.DiscountApprovalStatus__c) != 'Approved' )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: DCS Bundle discount exceeds 30% cap. Approval required from Deal Desk or CFO.
